cells.gaps: Nothing found says how much ANAVA's funds have invested in startups.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-15: about 1,400 to 1,450 firms hold the label under Law 2018-20 (TUN-003, TUN-005), and ANAVA, the fund of funds under the Startup Tunisia programme (TUN-010), has financed 10 funds through which 70 startups were financed (TUN-007). Every rung is met, so 4 to 5.
